basic_info.description: Set in the heart of San Francisco's iconic Castro District, this beautifully remodeled upper-floor Victorian condo offers timeless charm with thoughtful modern upgrades. Featuring two spacious bedrooms, two updated bathrooms and in-unit laundry, the home blends classic architectural details with stylish, contemporary finishes.  The updated kitchen showcases tasteful design, and the living and dining areas provide a warm, comfortable setting for everyday living or entertaining. Large windows fill the space with natural light, highlighting the elegance of the home's period character.  Tucked away on a quiet one-way street, the building enjoys added privacy while remaining just steps from the energy of Castro Village. Dedicated parking, a well-maintained building, and a location close to restaurants, nightlife, public transit, and Dolores Park make this a rare and inviting opportunity in one of the city's most beloved neighborhoods.  The property is in the final stages of condo conversion.  HOA dues are planned for $375/mo.
